explicitMultiSimulationIsolation.reason: Surefire does not discover the *IT class in its default test-name patterns

exactOutput.rng: Legacy Apache Commons Math MersenneTwister; housing.rng does not exist at this revision

originalMasterVersusCurrentArray.note: A clean original-master run on the same toolchain used the same materialized config and matched all 26 manifest entries.

staleBecauseSourceChanged.mechanism: data/Wealth and BinnedDataDouble feed data.Wealth.getDesiredBankBalance at Household.java:66, i.e. every household's initial bank balance, so every output file necessarily differs.

historicalTrackedManifest.interpretation: Stale by source change, not by platform: the model source changed between this manifest's commit and the original-master baseline, so a 25/25 mismatch is expected and is not evidence of a defect. Retained unchanged. The meaningful check is that current b07fd6b matches original master 7772f3e exactly on this platform, which passed; the new manifest is the migration control for this toolchain.

platformLock.reason: The model calls java.lang.Math.exp and Math.pow rather than StrictMath -- including Config.java:381-382, where derived parameters are computed, so any difference propagates into every household and every output file. Java specifies these to within 1 ulp and semi-monotonicity but NOT to cross-implementation identity; only StrictMath guarantees that.
platformLock.consequence: This manifest is a valid byte-identity oracle ONLY on the recording platform and JDK. The Plan-of-Record Step 3 gate ('facade must reproduce byte-for-byte') MUST therefore be verified on this same machine. Verifying it on ccgpu4 against this manifest would fail all 26 entries spuriously.
platformLock.howToConfirmIfEverNeeded: Run the same snapshot/mode at b07fd6b on ccgpu4 and compare; a mismatch there with matching config entry confirms platform sensitivity. Not required in order to proceed -- the safe rule (verify on the recording platform) costs nothing.
platformLock.relatedDecision: Independently supports PROJECT_STATE.md section 6c: 'do not require whole-model byte identity across CPU and GPU'. It is not achievable across CPUs either.

canonicalPublishedValidation.role: Published 20-metric provenance only; it is not the interim Philox comparator
canonicalPublishedValidation.willNotMatchFinalGateEither: The recomputed 20-metric null at final gate will also differ from this 0.5864: it uses 8 seeds and window 200-2000, where this used 10 seeds and window 500-3500. The difference is seeds and window, not only metric count. Do not treat convergence toward 0.5864 as expected or its absence as a defect.

nullControl20260814.provenanceCaveat: The retained summary and log do not embed a Git commit. Their attribution to b07fd6b is documented contemporaneously in GPU_RESULTS_LOG.md.

interimGate.rule: baselineSet1 plus or minus two sample standard deviations
interimGate.doNotSubstitute: The separately printed empirical central-95-percent interval is not the plan-of-record gate

finalGate.method: Rescore the same 160 retained outputs after WAS access, then recompute the Mersenne null under identical settings
